# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

Hi, I need a little help with an order.

I had a whole “remote work in Seattle, become one with nature” plan, so I ordered three home office items plus some hiking stuff. Now my company has hit me with the classic plot twist: we’re going back to the office soon.

So I’m hoping I can cancel or return just the office items and keep the hiking items. I honestly don’t remember exactly which items in the order were the office ones, but there should be three of them. Could you check what my options are and tell me how much I’d get back total? If possible, I’d like the refund to go back to my original payment method.

If partial cancellation/return isn’t possible, then no worries, I’ll just keep the order and move on with my life like a slightly confused outdoor-themed office worker. In that case, could you update my default profile address to the Seattle parent-house address that’s already on the order? I’d rather not type the full address out here.

My name is Noah Patel, and I’m currently in New York, 10108. I don’t remember which email I used, unfortunately.
noah_patel_6952
